text:
Alex: Quick update — BlueQuartz signed the EAP NDA this morning. Legal sent the fully executed copy to me.
Maria: awesome, can you drop the NDA in the shared drive? I need it for marketplace listing prep.
Alex: Uploaded to GDrive: https://drive.redwood/bluequartz/nda_signed.pdf :thumbsup:
Jordan: Heads-up — BlueQuartz wants us to run two baseline configs: fp16 + int8-4bit quant. They also asked for tail-latency numbers under 4k token workload.
Samir: I can spin up the dedicated pool for this. Need the model variant and sample prompts.
Nico: I'll send sample prompt sets (internal + customer-like) by EOD. Also want to validate telemetry fields we agreed: model_id, gpu_type, seq_len, batch_size, latency_p95.
Kevin: On the marketplace side we need the logo, short blurb, and legal-safe joint announcement window. Legal prefers no press until week of Apr 6.
Alex: BlueQuartz is fine with Apr 6, but wants a short pre-announce to their SI partners on Apr 1. Do we need sign-off from product?
Maria: Product sign-off checklist: benchmarks pass baseline, regression <1% generation quality, and infra runbook complete.
Jordan: For benchmarks I'll use the following script, copied here:
```
./run_bench --model redwood-3b --quant int8 --seq 4096 --batch 4 --probe telemetry.json
```
Samir: I'll provide nodes with A100 and BQ-X (BlueQuartz accelerator). Please tag runs with `bq-eap-2026`.
BenchmarkBot: New benchmark job queued by Jordan — job id bj-4287. ETA 2h.
Nico: Reminder: include warmup of 500 tokens for cache priming.
Kevin: I'll draft the marketplace listing copy and share in #docs-review tomorrow.
Alex: Action items — Maria attach NDA link to marketplace PR, Jordan run fp16 and int8 tests by tomorrow noon, Samir provision BQ nodes, Nico upload prompt sets, Kevin draft marketplace + announce timeline.
Maria: noted. I'll coordinate with Legal for short joint statement and send to product for sign-off.
Samir: provisioning started, ETA 3 hours.
Jordan: starting fp16 run now.
BenchmarkBot: job bj-4287 finished — fp16 p95=38ms, p99=86ms, tokens/sec=620. int8 run queued as bj-4288.
Alex: nice. Can someone capture the perf table and add to the shared doc?
Nico: I'll take it and add a quick perf summary + caveats about dataset skew.
Kevin: Also looping in partnerships@bluequartz for the Apr 1 SI heads note.
Alex: Thanks all — will reconvene tomorrow 10am PT if there are any blockers. :calendar:
